comments.text: Suppose you are me. Write an academic and formal letter to university of Siena and express my enthusiasm to continue my graduate studies in Language and Mind: Linguistics and Cognitive Studies in Siena.  Kindly ask them that I cannot access their fellowship website: https://www.dsu.toscana.it/servizi/benefici-agli-studenti/students-from-abroad-studenti-residenti-estero/, and I am eager to know whether this program offers any funding/fellowship/scholarship positions for International students. In the end, thank them for their time and consideration.
